subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-table Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add first-class channel tabs plus a merged all-channel timeline?
rationale: Current main partially solves channel organization, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Sufficient
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the Sessions table Group by channel surface is the intended Control UI answer.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current implementation and docs update came through steipete's session grouping work.
